title: Inference Guidance Tour — compact cards & microcopy for batching, cache hints, and quant controls
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a short, skippable guided tour and a set of compact UI cards that surface actionable batching, prefix/KV cache, and quantization recommendations inside the Optimize toolkit onboarding flow. Assets should work as: 1) first-run tooltip tour for new users; 2) compact cards for the onboarding checklist and docs landing page; and 3) screenshot-ready art for release notes. Focus on clear microcopy, a 3-state card (suggested, auto-applied, manual override), and accessible color/contrast for inline tips.
design_notes: Use 3-card pattern: 'Why', 'Suggested Action', 'Impact (latency/cost)'. Keep copy under 90 chars per line.
Include a condensed, keyboard-navigable tooltip variant for accessibility and quick keyboard tours.
Show safe defaults with an explicit 'Apply' CTA and a smaller 'Learn more' link to the docs modal.
Quantization card should include a short explanation of tradeoffs (speed ↔️ quality) and a link to run a quick eval job.
Cache card should illustrate prefix vs. full-response caching with a small diagram (40x40 px icon).
Batched inference card should show expected throughput delta using two micro-metrics: median latency and cost-per-token estimate.
Create a high-contrast variant for dark mode and ensure icons follow existing Redwood iconography.
Prepare AE (After Effects) micro-animation spec for card flip when user toggles 'Auto-apply suggestions'.
acceptance_criteria: Three responsive mockups (tooltip tour, onboarding checklist card, docs landing card) uploaded to Drive and linked below.
Microcopy reviewed and approved by PM and Eng, with at most two copy iterations noted in comments.
Design tokens and color hex values documented in the spec for frontend handoff.
Engineering sign-off on interaction states (hover, focused, disabled) and accessibility checklist completed.
Two release-ready screenshots (light/dark) exported at 2x and 3x for marketing and release notes.
Animated microinteraction spec attached in Lottie/JSON or AE file for handoff.
